name: Manual
for: documentation for a tool, library, API, product or house handbook
description: A docs page people can actually work from: a sidebar of chapters (a disclosure on a phone), the page's own contents, an install step in a code block with its output, callouts for notes and warnings, an options table that scrolls inside itself on a phone, and previous and next links. Plain sans for reading, a monospace for code; dark mode is the terminal at night.
